gateway.route: New explicit exact /v1/node CloudFront behavior, HTTPS viewer, no cache, single origin connection attempt, private VPC origin directly targeting query HTTP port. Preserve website routing. No broad /prover/* rewrite needed. All other operator paths including health/jobs/compact/admin stay unavailable at this behavior.
gateway.isolation: Raw node8082/admin8882 stay loopback. Query HTTP private-origin listener accepts ingress only from the actual CloudFront service-managed VPC-origin security group; no public origin or general VPC ingress. No client-supplied forwarded header becomes authority. Auth is mandatory even with missing Origin.

Reuse startProverService query-only, no proof queue/worker; no separate coordinator.
gateway.releaseAccess: Use explicit read-only ACL/group plan for the verified public release that allows both query and later prover identity without access to root-private files. Existing activation chown must preserve the query reader rights; this requires a reviewed adjustment, not an assumed compatible lifecycle. No duplicated mutable SDK tree.

delivery.envelope: Only schema/campaign/source/manifest hashes and actual public scope/evidence matching all precommitted identities. No commands, local paths, arbitrary URL, environment or secret. Its fixed byte cap must fit the existing separately bounded scope/evidence readers.
